name: Onmyoji
description: Templates the Onmyoji pack needs. Wording is from the English Steam client, verified on a live game. Capture at the window size you will bot at. IMPORTANT: crop DISTINCTIVE content (words, banners, icons) — never a bare button. Onmyoji reuses one button chrome everywhere, and a crop that is mostly flat fill was measured matching a completely different button at 0.91.

templates.name: onmyoji_battle_ready.png
templates.description: ON DEMAND. The button that STARTS a fight — the diamond 'Challenge' on an activity screen (挑战 / 准备 / 开始战斗). Crop the word only; leave out the ticket count under it, that number changes.

templates.name: onmyoji_reward_confirm.png
templates.description: AFTER A FIGHT. The 'Tap to continue' line at the bottom of the post-battle reward screen (确定 / 点击继续). Every farming macro uses this to clear results.

templates.name: onmyoji_realmraid_attack.png
templates.description: ON DEMAND. The 'Attack' button in the popup you get after clicking a Realm Raid target. Not on the target list itself — select a target first.

templates.name: onmyoji_realmraid_refresh.png
templates.description: ON DEMAND. The 'Refresh' button at the bottom right of the Realm Raid target list.

templates.name: onmyoji_mail_claim.png
templates.description: ON DEMAND. The mailbox bulk button — 'Read All' on the English client. Reading is what grants attachments here, so this is the claim-all. Mailbox → System Mail, bottom left.

templates.name: onmyoji_signin_claim.png
templates.description: EVENT-DEPENDENT. The sign-in / check-in CLAIM button. Note: the 'Bonus' lantern is NOT it — that lists active buff timers. Onmyoji has no permanent daily sign-in; the check-in lives inside whatever event is running (Event → Exciting Events), so this button MOVES and RESTYLES between events. Re-capture it when the event rotates, and expect the Daily Sign-in macro to need it re-done.

templates.name: onmyoji_level_up.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC. The shikigami LEVEL-UP popup — crop its BANNER or title text, NOT the OK button. The macro presses OK by position once this banner is seen.

templates.name: onmyoji_defeat.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC. The battle DEFEAT screen — crop the 'Defeat'/失败 banner, NOT the OK button. The macro presses OK by position once this banner is seen.

templates.name: onmyoji_captcha.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC — cannot be summoned; grab it the moment you ever see one. ANTI-BAN: the verification / CAPTCHA screen. Macros STOP on this instead of clicking through, so capture it carefully. Until it is captured, that guard does nothing.

templates.name: onmyoji_out_of_stamina.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC — appears only when you are actually out. The 'not enough AP / 体力 / 勾玉' popup. Crop its message text. Stops the AP farms.

templates.name: onmyoji_no_attempts.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC — appears only once the daily limit is spent. The 'no attempts left / 次数已用完' state. Crop its message text. Stops Bounty, Realm Raid and Demon.

templates.name: onmyoji_inventory_full.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC — appears only when storage fills. The 'storage / inventory full' popup. Crop its message text. Stops the macro so you can clear space.

templates.name: onmyoji_reconnect_retry.png
templates.description: OPPORTUNISTIC — appears only on a network drop. The reconnect / network-error RETRY button, auto-clicked to recover. Include the surrounding message text so it is distinctive.

templates.name: onmyoji_challenge_again.png
templates.description: OPTIONAL. A 'Challenge again' / 再次挑战 button, if your client shows one after a win. The English Steam client does not — it returns to the activity screen instead, so leave this uncaptured and battle_ready is used.
